description: This PHP class defines BigPipeResponse, a specialized HTTP response used in Drupal's BigPipe module to send content in chunks, managing placeholders, headers, and session handling.

classes.name: BigPipeResponse
classes.description: A response class that sends content in chunks via the BigPipe service, extending HtmlResponse and implementing session management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the response with an original HtmlResponse and populates its data accordingly.

methods.name: populateBasedOnOriginalHtmlResponse
methods.description: Copies headers, content, attachments, and cache metadata from the original response and sets headers for surrogate control and streaming.

methods.name: setBigPipeService
methods.description: Assigns the BigPipe service to the response.

methods.name: sendContent
methods.description: Uses the BigPipe service to send content and updates attachments after processing placeholders.
